svg.text: • ROLE ↔ PERMISSION is M:M via ROLE_PERMISSION
• Every PET belongs to one USER (owner); USER → PET = 1:M
• USER authors POST, COMMENT, QUESTION, ADVICE, ARTICLE (each USER 1:M)
• POST ↔ USER: M:M via POST_LIKE and POST_SAVE
PetMed | Sprint II — Entity Relationship Diagram
PK = Primary Key • FK = Foreign Key
Relationship notation: 1:M = one-to-many; M:1 = many-to-one; M:M = many-to-many via junction table.
For each 1:M line, the reverse direction is M:1. Optional participation is indicated as 0..1. User links across sections are documented in notes.
